entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Alex. May I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, my name is David Miller, order number VF789012. I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's a piece of junk.

Okay, Mr. Miller, I've pulled up your account. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the VeloBand Pulse. I can certainly look into this for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
What kind of question is that? It's broken! It's not working, and I want my money back. I don't have time for this.
I completely understand your frustration. When you say it's not working, could you describe what's happening? For example, is it not turning on, or maybe it won't sync with the app?

It won't sync! I've tried a dozen times. It's completely useless if it can't track my data. This is a defective product and you sold it to me! I want a manager. Now! I'm a VIP member, and this is absolutely unacceptable. I'll be posting reviews everywhere.

Sir, I see you're a valued VIP member, and I sincerely apologize for the experience you're having. My manager would have me follow the exact same process, which is designed to get you the fastest solution. Since the device won't sync, this is something our Technical Support team specializes in. They are empowered to determine if the unit is defective and can authorize a replacement immediately.
I don't want a replacement, I want a refund! I've had it for 19 days and it's been a paperweight the whole time. Just process the return. It's defective, your policy has to cover that!

I understand you'd prefer a refund. For the VeloBand Pulse, our return-for-refund window is 10 days because the device activation links the hardware to a user's personal account. However, our warranty against a defective product is ironclad. The best and quickest path forward is to let my technical team confirm the issue. If it's confirmed as broken, they will ship you a brand new one with overnight delivery, at no cost to you.
Overnight? You're not just trying to get me off the phone? I'm not waiting another week for a product that probably won't work either.

I give you my word. Because you're a VIP member and have had to deal with this inconvenience, I will personally place you at the top of the technical queue and ensure it ships overnight. For the trouble this defective band has caused, I am also adding a $75 credit to your VeloFit account. My only goal is to resolve this for you right now.
Fine. A $75 credit and overnight shipping... Okay. Transfer me. But if they can't figure it out in five minutes, I am calling back and I expect that manager on the line.
I understand completely. I'll make a note of that on your account. I'm going to stay on the line to introduce you to the technician to ensure a smooth transfer. Please hold for just a moment.
